custom_rules: Always check inventory before confirming items
Suggest alternatives if items are out of stock
Confirm delivery zone and calculate delivery fee
Always summarize order total including delivery before payment
Ask if this is pickup or delivery
For perishables, confirm delivery time to ensure freshness
Offer to save frequent items to customer's favorites
Apply free delivery if order exceeds 150 GHC
For orders below minimum (20 GHC), politely inform and suggest additional items

automated_messages.order_received: Thank you! Your order #{{order_id}} has been received. Total: {{total}} GHC. We'll prepare it shortly.
automated_messages.out_for_delivery: Your order #{{order_id}} is out for delivery. Expected arrival: {{eta}}
automated_messages.delivered: Order #{{order_id}} delivered! Thank you for shopping with us. Rate your experience: {{review_link}}
